verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap's own integration docs describe automatic Google Drive→Google Sheets and Google Drive→Zapier Table transcription workflows. The API also runs async jobs that report back through completion and cancel webhooks, so transcription can happen hands-off in the background. However, the automation orchestration appears to rely on Zapier rather than a native scheduler or trigger engine. Missing for 10: native first-party automation or trigger configuration, scheduling or recurring-run controls, detail on how integrations are set up and maintained, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably.
